notes: Brigades are now assigned to sectors you choose, instead of the country being split evenly. Assign one from Forces › Order of battle, or tap the map and pick Brigade sector

A sector's size follows what the brigade can hold: personnel fill, morale, working vehicles, companies left and the local threat. Strong brigades in quiet areas cover a lot and can overlap; worn-down ones shrink
When the bases in a sector can't house the brigade, a brigade support area is set up at the center
New map overlays (buttons under Status): brigade sectors, and aviation coverage rings for helicopters, MEDEVAC, close air support and drones
